text: A good title should be more concrete than this. Since you actually narrow down your research in the exposee, try to reflect that in the title
Add here as well that we are talking about Germany, otherwise it is a bit confusing
in Germany*!
Source?
Good, and important motivation for your research
Try to stick more with the facts and not "over-dramatize"
Would be good to add some references here to show you have also looked at literature on AI in education

Two things:
Firstly, this could be more concrete - but at least you have several sub-RQs. Secondly, the question sounds ambiguous to me: Is it supposed to help improving teachers' mathematical skills as well? (Obviously not, but the question would sound like this)
Minor point: You probably chose \subsubsection or something here that it becomes 2.0.1 - but you would like it to be 2.1, which should be one level higher (so maybe \subsection)
This is a good sub-RQ to me. Clear focus, openly formulated and possible to be answered.
Good combination of material
What is this sentence trying to say? As is, it doesn't add any value to the SOTA presentation
I don't know whether the a,b,c for footnotes was part of the template or not, but I personally find it difficult to read. But won't count as a problem, just a minor comment from my side :)
Don't repeat yourself too much, this is almost exactly the same as in the first part of the SOTA
Quite surprising to me - I don't really see the connection to the research questions...

The research questions are very wide and open. I don't believe that they suffice to answer the general research question, it is too generic to be fully answered. Try to focus on less research questions, but define them in more detail, and think whether you will be able to answer the RQs in your potential thesis
there "seems to be" or there "is" - would be a difference :)
Good, and also clear to me why it is relevant
What do you mean by this environment? An "AI platform"?
What is the "AI system"? When has it been introduced, what are its goals?

It does not become clear to me whether building the platform is part of the thesis or not. Furthermore, how do you plan to answer all your research questions with your methodology? Try to tailor it towards your research questions to have a better structure in your research
Good paragraph, but why did you call it "I [...] create a tailored AI platform" in the SOTA section if you just choose a platform?
Good addition on top of the theoretical framework

I disagree. If you want to create personalized education options for everyone, you should also include everyone in your survey and not tailor your test group towards the best possible outcome, skewing the results of overall acceptance and effectiveness
Your methodology is not clearly answering the research questions, whereas the choice and the "finetuning" of a platform was not even mentioned in the research questions at all.
I don't see the relevance of this, and you don't seem to reference this later or build your research on top of this
What does this actually mean? What is "configuring" etc? You never specified the details of it in your exposee
I like your inclusion of a feedback loop, and how you plan to do two testing phases to improve upon the feedback
